executive_summary: The Cognizant Classic field presents intriguing value opportunities with several players showing stronger profiles than their odds suggest. Ryan Gerard leads the favorites at +1709 with solid course history including a 4th place finish in 2023, while Shane Lowry at +2232 brings exceptional course form with back-to-back top-5 finishes in 2023-2024. Max McGreevy stands out as a potential value play at +4276, bouncing back from early struggles with a strong T4 finish in 2025 after missing the cut in 2023.

insights.title: Gerard's Course Mastery Continues
insights.insight: Ryan Gerard sits atop the betting board at +1709 with strong course history, posting a 4th place finish in 2023 and a respectable T25 in 2025. His consistent performance at this venue makes him a solid favorite play.

insights.title: Lowry's Remarkable Course Consistency
insights.insight: Shane Lowry has been money at this event with a T5 in 2023 and T4 in 2024, showing elite course fit. At +2232, he offers strong value given his proven track record here.

insights.title: McGreevy's Redemption Story Brewing
insights.insight: Max McGreevy bounced back dramatically from a 2023 MC to post a T4 finish in 2025, suggesting he's figured out this course. At +4276, he presents excellent value for his recent form.

insights.title: Hojgaard Brothers' Concerning Pattern
insights.insight: Both Nicolai (+2474) and Rasmus Hojgaard (+2862) missed the cut in 2024 before improving to T18 finishes in 2025. Their inconsistent course history makes them risky plays despite favorable odds.

insights.title: Thompson's Troubling Course Record
insights.insight: Davis Thompson has struggled mightily at this venue with a MC in 2023, T47 in 2024, and another MC in 2025. His +4613 odds don't adequately reflect his poor course fit.

insights.title: Berger's Mixed Course Signals
insights.insight: Daniel Berger missed the cut in 2024 but rebounded to a T25 finish in 2025, showing potential course improvement. At +4904, he could offer sneaky value if the upward trend continues.

insights.title: Thorbjornsen's Debut Performance
insights.insight: Michael Thorbjornsen posted a solid T39 in his 2025 debut at this event. At +3292, his lack of extensive course history makes him a risky but potentially rewarding play.

insights.title: Mitchell's Unknown Course Equation
insights.insight: Keith Mitchell enters at +3491 with no recent course history data available, making him a complete wildcard. His odds suggest bookmakers see potential, but lack of course knowledge is concerning.
